verdict.rationale: Lago publishes an API reference with versioning guarantees, a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 schema (confirmed by probe returning HTTP 200 at /openapi.json), and curl examples for core endpoints like event ingestion; the docs also call out exposing billing actions to AI agents. A community user praises the API as well designed. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving end-to-end workflows purely via the API (e.g. agent-driven usage reports).
